channel.description: Independent viewing guides for restoration, factory process, and practical engineering videos.

item.title: Antique 1930s Meat Slicer Restoration - Bringing a Forgotten Machine... | Restoration Process Guide
item.description: This viewing guide accompanies "Antique 1930s Meat Slicer Restoration - Bringing a Forgotten Machine Back to Life" by Cool Again Restoration.
